pdf.title: Save as PDF
pdf.intro: Your browser's print window opens next. To get a PDF:
pdf.chrome.1: Next to Destination, choose Save as PDF.
pdf.chrome.2: Select Save, then pick where to keep the file.
pdf.firefox.1: Next to Destination, choose Save to PDF.
pdf.firefox.2: Select Save, then pick where to keep the file.
pdf.safari.1: At the bottom left, open the PDF menu.
pdf.safari.2: Choose Save as PDF, then Save.
pdf.ios.1: In the print window, tap the Share button at the top.
pdf.ios.2: Tap Save to Files, or share it straight to Mail or WhatsApp.
pdf.android.1: At the top, tap the printer name and choose Save as PDF.
pdf.android.2: Tap the round PDF button, then Save.

set.installIntro: Install InvoGen to open it from your home screen or dock like any other app. It works offline either way.
set.installed: InvoGen is installed on this device.
set.ios1: In Safari, tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
set.ios2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
set.ios3: Tap Add. InvoGen now opens from your home screen.
set.installManual: Open your browser’s menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen. If you don’t see it, your browser can’t install apps; InvoGen still works offline in the browser.
set.dataIntro: Everything is stored only in this browser on this device. Nothing is uploaded. Export a backup now and then, and keep the file somewhere safe.
set.backupTooLarge: That file is too large to be an InvoGen backup.
set.backupNotOurs: That file isn’t an InvoGen backup. Choose a file you exported from InvoGen.

set.sampleHint: Adds example clients and documents so you can try everything. Remove them in one step.
set.sampleOnHint: Sample data is on this device. Removing it deletes only the examples.
set.guideHint: Five short steps from your business details to a finished PDF.
set.helpNone: Nothing matches. Try a shorter word.
set.g.first.a: Choose Create, add your client and what you are billing for. The preview updates as you type and everything saves automatically.
set.g.pdf.a: Open a document and choose PDF. The PDF file is made on your device and downloads straight away, with no print window. On a phone or tablet, choose Download or Share when it’s ready. Choose Print to use a printer.
set.g.send.q: Send a document to a client
set.g.send.a: In the editor, choose Send. Your email app opens with the message filled in. Attach the PDF you saved and send it. The document is then marked as sent.
set.g.payment.a: Open the ⋯ menu on an invoice and choose Record payment. Part payments are fine: the balance goes down and the status changes to Partially paid or Paid.
set.g.overdue.q: When does an invoice become overdue?
set.g.overdue.a: The day after its due date, if it isn’t fully paid. If you turned on late fees, they are added automatically after the grace days.
set.g.recurring.a: In the editor, open Recurring and choose how often. A new draft is made each time the date comes round, the next time you open InvoGen.
set.g.import.q: Import items or clients from a spreadsheet
set.g.import.a: Copy rows from Excel or Google Sheets and paste them, or choose a CSV or Excel file. Columns such as Description, Qty, Price, Name and Email are recognised.
set.g.templates.a: Pick the look for new documents on Templates. For one document, open Design in the editor to change its template, colour, font and paper.
set.g.backup.a: Your data lives only in this browser. Export a backup regularly and keep the file safe. Import it to restore, or to move to another device or browser.
set.g.offline.a: After the first visit InvoGen works with no connection. Install it to open it like an app from your home screen or dock.
set.g.languages.a: The app language changes the menus. Each document has its own language for its headings; change it in the editor under Language and formats.

remind.title: Send a payment reminder
remind.body.upcoming:
Hello {name},

A quick reminder that {doc} for {amount} is due on {due}.

If you have already paid, please ignore this message. Thank you!

{biz}
remind.body.friendly:
Hello {name},

I hope you are well. {doc} for {amount} was due on {due} and is still open. Could you please arrange payment when you get a chance?

If you have already paid, thank you, and please ignore this message.

{biz}
remind.body.final:
Hello {name},

This is a final reminder that {doc} for {amount} is overdue by {days} (it was due on {due}). Please pay the outstanding amount within 7 days.

If you have already paid, please send me the payment details so I can update my records.

{biz}

ab.title: Automatic backup
ab.intro: Save a copy of everything to a folder on this computer each time something changes. Choose a folder your cloud drive syncs (OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive) and the copies are kept off this device too.
ab.unsupported: Automatic backup to a folder works in Chrome and Edge on a computer. In this browser, use Export backup regularly and keep the file somewhere safe.
ab.keeps: One file per day, named “InvoGen backup” with the date. The last 30 days are kept.
ab.paused: Automatic backup to {folder} is paused. Your browser needs your permission again to use the folder.
ab.pausedBanner: Automatic backup is paused. Allow InvoGen to use your backup folder again.
ab.started: Automatic backup is on. The first copy is saved.
ab.denied: Permission wasn't given. Automatic backup stays paused.
ab.failed: The last automatic backup could not be saved. Check that the folder still exists, then choose Back up now.
ab.stopped: Automatic backup is off. Files already saved stay in the folder.

lock.forgotMsg: For your security, a forgotten PIN can't be recovered. You can erase everything InvoGen keeps on this device and start again, then restore your latest backup file.
lock.intro: Ask for a PIN when InvoGen opens, and again after it has been left alone. Useful on a shared or family device.
lock.after0: Right after I leave the app
lock.note: The PIN keeps other people out of the app on this device. It doesn't encrypt the data your browser stores, so keep your device itself locked too.
lock.unsupported: App lock needs a secure (https) connection.
lock.forgetWarn: Don't forget it: a forgotten PIN can only be cleared by erasing the data on this device.
lock.setDone: PIN set. InvoGen now locks when you leave it.
set.g.remind.a: Open the ⋯ menu on a sent invoice and choose Send a payment reminder. The tone follows how late the invoice is and how many reminders you sent before; you can change it. Each reminder is recorded on the invoice.
set.g.credit.q: Refund or correct an invoice (credit note)
set.g.credit.a: Open the ⋯ menu on the invoice and choose Create a credit note. Remove or change lines for a part credit, then issue it. Its total comes off the invoice's balance; if the invoice was already paid, the difference is what you owe back.
set.g.types.q: Proformas, purchase orders and delivery notes
set.g.types.a: Choose the type at the top of the editor. A proforma works like an estimate and can be turned into an invoice. A purchase order is sent to a supplier. A delivery note lists goods without prices and has a line for the receiver to sign.
set.g.reports.a: Open Reports from the menu or the Documents page. Pick a period and currency to see net sales, money received, what clients owe and the tax collected. Export CSV gives your accountant the details.
set.g.bulk.a: On Documents, choose Select, tick the documents, then mark them sent or paid, export them to CSV or delete them. Undo is offered for a few seconds.
set.g.autoBackup.a: In Chrome or Edge on a computer, open Settings › Your data › Automatic backup and choose a folder. A copy is saved there after every change. Pick a folder your cloud drive syncs to keep copies off the device.
set.g.lock.q: Lock the app with a PIN
set.g.lock.a: Open Settings › App lock and set a PIN of 4 to 8 digits. Choose how soon InvoGen locks again after you leave it. A forgotten PIN can only be cleared by erasing this device's data, so keep a backup.
